description.en: A living reconstruction of Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus with a small head, long neck, broad body and four flippers. The holotype anchors the model, but soft tissues, flipper margins and colour are inferred.
description.zh: Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus的活体复原，呈现小头、长颈、宽躯与四鳍肢。以正模为依据，软组织、鳍缘及颜色为推断。

evidence_anchors.classification: Storrs1997 publisher search-index abstract restricts Plesiosaurus to dolichodeirus and junior synonyms, notes nonspatulate symphysis,~40cervicals and slightly longer forelimbs. Full chapter403 unavailable, not claimed read. Do not import former Plesiosaurus species now Seeleyosaurus/Meyerasaurus.
evidence_anchors.pose: Noe,Taylor,Gomez-Perez2017 original article read. Its empirical exemplars are Muraenosaurus,Cryptoclidus,Tricleidus, NOT this holotype. Group-level osteological discussion supports conservative low-curvature neck instead of swanlike vertical S; feeding hypothesis not treated as established for this species.
evidence_anchors.scale: Paul Sea Reptile Masses and Dimensions, p2: Plesiosaurus dolichoderius NMH22656 estimated3.1m; OXFUM J.10304 is separate3.4m specimen and not used. Actual table page visually checked.
evidence_anchors.whole: The paleobear2017 actual NHM holotype photograph: small skull at right, long cervical chain, broad ribcage, four paddle skeletons, short tapering caudal series at left. Some cervical and limb bones are displaced; do not reproduce fossil breaks as anatomical gaps. NHM museum article identifies this specimen as the Mary Anning holotype.

morphology: Small narrow low head with gently tapered snout and rear cranial volume, not a broad pliosaur head, ichthyosaur needle rostrum or crocodilian bulbous spatulate muzzle. Modest8degree jaw opening can show small slender pointed teeth;~20perjawside is simplified representation, not an exact dental count.

Long cylindrical but gently tapering fleshed neck, substantially longer than trunk and about the trunk+tail length. Base broadens into shoulder. Keep nearly horizontal with only gentle ventral/lateral curvature, no swan S, cobra hood or disconnected beads.
Broad oval trunk with substantial rounded flank and ventrum, distinctly broader than the neck. Avoid either a thin ribbon or a spherical turtle shell. No external ribs, girdle holes or slab.

Four conspicuous elongate hydrofoil flippers, both pairs similarly substantial with forepair slightly longer. Narrow tapering rounded tips and fleshed roots; no separated land fingers or claws. Preserve negative spaces between anterior and posterior pairs.

Relatively short tapering tail, distinctly shorter than neck. No giant ichthyosaur/mosasaur crescent fin or dolphin flukes. A simple conservative tapered terminal outline is not proof that every small soft-tissue fringe was absent.
Muted gray-green dorsal and lighter ventral color is artistic inference. No speculative armor, dorsal body fin, crocodilian scales or conspicuous fixed skin pattern.

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: small head on a long neck above a broad four-flipper body.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：长颈小头与宽四鳍肢躯干。

scale.interpretation: 3.1m is an author-published reconstruction estimate. All component dimensions above are modeling estimates constrained by the skeleton, not independent caliper readings. Neck is near the combined trunk+tail length; skull distinctly small. Flattened slab width is not literal living depth. Maintain plausible fleshed volume and allow modest adjustment rather than fake measurement precision.

scientific_limits.en: The holotype photo shows actual bones with crushing, displaced cervical elements and incomplete/disarticulated paddle details; it is not an intact soft-tissue outline.3.1m is Paul's published estimated total length for specimen22656, not a fresh direct measurement. The table misspells dolichodeirus and abbreviates the institution NMH; accession22656 and specimen context identify the intended holotype. NHM's generic around3.5m statement is not assigned to this individual. Neck/torso flesh, paddle margins, tail skin, eyes and colors are inferred. Neck functional evidence from other plesiosaur genera is used only to justify a conservative near-straight pose, not species-specific joint measurements.
scientific_limits.zh: 真标本照片存在压扁、颈椎移位及部分鳍肢细节散乱，不是完整软组织轮廓。3.1米为Paul对22656标本的发表估计全长，并非新实测；表内种名拼写及NMH缩写有笔误，以标本号与语境对应正模。NHM约3.5米的属级介绍不当作该个体实测。肉体、鳍缘、尾皮、眼与配色推定。其他蛇颈龙属的颈功能研究仅辅助保守近直姿态，不冒充本种关节测量。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus, principally based on the holotype NHMUK PV OR22656. Flesh covers the small head, long neck, broad ribcage, four flippers and relatively short tail. Not a fossil slab or skull-only asset.

acceptance: Lateral front and perspective retain small head and long gently curved neck without swan posture.
Top reveals broad oval torso and four separate well-spaced elongate hydrofoils, both pairs substantial.
Tail is short relative to neck; no whale flukes or fishlike caudal fin.
Model remains whole living animal, with no fossil gaps, exposed bones or unsupported elaborate skin ornament.
shape_gate.comparisons: Nothosaurus has much shorter neck relative to trunk and tail, conspicuous elongated constricted fang-bearing head, jointed partly webbed limbs and long tapering tail. Simosaurus has a broader blunt head and relatively shorter neck. Platecarpus has short neck, mosasaur head and a long regionalized downturned caudal fin; it is not a plesiosaur body.
shape_gate.required_combination: Very small head, long neck around trunk+tail length, broad oval torso and four similarly substantial hydrofoil flippers. The combination must read independently of label/color/scale/pose.
